resources.content:
#Intensive 1.0 - New Job Tracks Announcement Happy news! We are thrilled to announce that we have expanded our range of job tracks to better equip you for your future careers. Alongside the MERN Full Stack track, we have now introduced two new tracks: *QA/Automation Testing* and *Data Analytics*. Also, we are providing an opportunity to all the intensive students to switch their job track if they are interested in these new tracks. Following are the details about each job track:
*QA/Automation Testing Curriculum:* - The QA job track covers automation testing with Selenium using Java. - Java fundamentals are a prerequisite for this track. - Java fundamentals will be taught based on the Programming Foundations(Python) you have learnt during Fundamentals Growth Cycle. *Data Analytics Curriculum:* - Please note that daily 1-hour sessions will be provided for the data analytics job track, with the remaining time available for practice and revision. ### Major Changes when you switch the job track #### Grading System - After completing each course, you will be given a *course-wise exam*, and your performance will be evaluated through a grading system. Based on the score obtained, you will be assigned a grade. - For example, a score of 90 or above will earn you an A grade, while a score between 70-80 will receive a B grade. These grades will be assigned for all scores between 0 to 100. - Furthermore, an *overall cumulative grade* will be assigned based on your performance across all courses. This grade will *reflect your overall progress and success in your chosen job track*. - It's important to note that while your grades will be a significant factor in your placement process, they will not be the sole determining factor. However, higher grades will certainly increase your chances of securing a job in your preferred field. #### Placement Process As you progress through the program, upon *completing all of the courses and attempting each course exam*, your placement preparation process starts. The placement preparation is meticulously crafted to provide you with support, including *resume building, offering interview preparation sessions, and conducting personalized one-on-one mock interviews* to help you hone your interview skills. Please note that different companies may have different eligibility requirements for their job openings. If you meet these requirements, you will be able to apply for the company. - It is important to *maintain good grades* throughout the program as this *can increase the number of opportunities available to you*. - Recruiters will have access to your grades and performance during the program and may use this information when considering candidates for job openings. #### IRC Eligibility Criteria To be eligible for the Industry-Ready Certification (IRC): - *Complete all projects* with given requirements and pass all plagiarism checks - *Complete Project Verification & Viva* - *Get a cumulative grade of minimum 7.5/10* #### What happens to the courses learnt in MERN Full Stack? You will be able to *access all the sessions you have completed till now* in MERN Full Stack. But, *new sessions of MERN Full Stack won't be unlocked*, as you will get the newly chosen job track's sessions in your daily schedule. Please follow the below steps if you want to switch to either *Automation Testing* or *Data Analytics*.
**1. Clearly understand the details about updated job tracks** Watch the following sessions to know the process, eligibility criteria, and all the other relevant information before making a decision to switch the job tracks: - Announcement - Attempting Company Assessments - FAQs
**2. Complete the Fundamentals Curriculum** The key to success in your career lies in acquiring the essential knowledge and skills. With a solid foundation in the basics, you can confidently take on any challenge and excel in your field. Therefore, it is recommended that you *complete the following Fundamental courses to become eligible for the exam and job track of your choice*: Build Your Own Static Website Build Your Own Responsive Website Introduction to Databases Programming Foundations with Python Foundations Exam - 1 Foundations Exam - 2
**3. Write the Fundamentals Exam** The Fundamentals Exam is simply to *suggest a suitable job track for you*, and *not to judge your skills*. Please *attempt it honestly*. - The Fundamentals Exam will be scheduled *for every 15 days*. - The Fundamentals Exam will unlock automatically only after you complete the above eligibility criteria. To ensure a smooth experience and prevent any technical issues during the exam, attempt Mock Fundamentals Exam
**4. Get Job Track Suggestion from Industry Experts** Once you write the Fundamentals Exam, seeking advice from industry experts can help you determine the most suitable job track for you. Their valuable insights and suggestions can guide you in making informed decisions and taking the right steps towards a successful career. Keep an open mind and be receptive to their feedback to maximize your potential. You can check the suggested job track for you here
**5. Submit your Job Track Preference** You can submit your preferred job track of your choice here
**6. Get access to your chosen Job Track** After submitting your preference form, you will gain access to the job track **after 24 hours**.
### Summary |Step | Task | Description| |:---: |:---: |:---:| |1 | Watch switching job track announcement session | Watch the session to know the process, eligibility criteria, and all the other relevant information| |2 | Complete the Fundamentals | Complete the following courses: Build Your Own Static Website, Build Your Own Responsive Website, Introduction to Databases, Programming Foundations with Python (Foundations Exam - 1 & 2)| |3 | Attempt Mock Fundamentals Exam | To ensure a smooth experience and prevent any technical issues during the exam.| |3 | Write the Fundamentals Exam| The Fundamentals Exam is simply to suggest a suitable job track for you, and not to judge your skills. Please attempt it honestly. It will unlock automatically only after you complete the above eligibility criteria.| |4 | Check Job Track Suggestion from Industry Experts | Once you complete the exam, you can check the suggestion from the industry experts on a suitable job track for you| |5 | Fill Job Track Preference Form | You can then submit your preferred job track, which is entirely your choice.| |6 | Get Access to your chosen Job Track | After submitting your preference form, you will gain access to the job track after 24 hours.| ## Frequently Asked Questions ### Switching Job Track
*When should I consider switching job track from MERN Fulll Stack to either Automation Testing or Data Analytics?* - MERN stack has more opportunities compared to other job tracks. We suggest you to continue with the MERN if you are comfortable with it. - However, if you are facing difficulty in your current path even after multiple attempts or feel that Automation Testing or Data Analytics aligns better with your interests and career goals, you can consider making the switch.
*Do I need to pay to access these new job tracks?* - No, you need not pay anything extra for switching to Automation Testing or Data Analytics.
*Can I opt for Java Full Stack?* - We are not suggesting Java Full stack. Because, if you are already finding difficulty in MERN, then Java will be a little more complex than MERN. - So, ideally it would be better if you can spend your energy and focus on either QA/Automation Testing or Data Analytics. - If you are comfortable with MERN, we recommend you to continue with it as MERN has lot of opportunities compared to other tracks.
*Can I switch back to the MERN track once I have selected any of the new job tracks?* - It's not recommended to switch between different tracks or decisions once you've made a choice. Changing your mind frequently can lead to *confusion, distraction, and lack of progress*. - If you keep switching job tracks multiple times, it can be challenging to focus on anything, and completing the course on time may become difficult. This can affect your placement support and delay your job placement. Therefore, it's best to avoid changing tracks frequently and stay committed to the decision you have made. This will help you stay on track and achieve your goals within the expected timeframe. - That's why it's important to think carefully before making a decision and then stick with it to stay committed and focused.
*Can I opt for any other job track while continuing in MERN? or can I learn multiple job tracks simultaneously?* - To maximize your skill-building potential, we suggest dedicating your full attention to one technology at a time. - Attempting to learn multiple technologies simultaneously can result in confusion and hinder your progress. - For this reason, we *only provide access to the job track that you choose*. - We encourage you to take the time to fully master one technology before considering another, which will help you achieve your career goals and secure a job placement more efficiently.
### Intensive 1.0
*Will the grading mechanism be introduced in Intensive 1.0?* - No, grading system won't be applicable for Intensive 1.0
### Fundamentals Exam
*What will happen if I fail the Fundamentals exam?* - We want to reassure you that the fundamentals exam is *not intended to be a pass or fail assessment*. Rather, it is designed *to evaluate your current knowledge and understanding of the fundamentals, and help identify the most appropriate job track for you*. Please be aware that your exam results will not be shared with recruiters, and are solely for our team's internal use in recommending the most suitable job track for you based on our expert analysis. - Our team will carefully review your exam submission and performance, and suggest the job track that best suits your skill level and career goals. It's important to note that completing the required fundamentals courses (Static, Responsive, Python till functions, and SQL) is mandatory before taking the exam. This is to ensure you have a solid foundation in these key areas, allowing you to take the exam with confidence and develop the necessary skills for your chosen career.
*Can l appear for the Fundamentals Exam only once?* - You *only need to take the fundamentals exam once*, as it is designed to assess your current level of knowledge and understanding, and recommend the most suitable job track for you. It is *not meant to be a pass or fail exam, and there is no need to take it multiple times*. - Our team of experts will carefully review your exam submission and performance, and provide you with a recommendation based on your skills and career aspirations. However, *if you feel that you need to further strengthen your knowledge and skills in the fundamental courses, we encourage you to revisit the course materials* and take advantage of the resources available to you, such as additional practice exercises and support from our instructors. - Ultimately, our goal is to help you succeed in your chosen career path, and we are committed to providing you with the necessary tools and guidance to achieve your goals.
*Why do I need to appear for the exam if the final decision is ours?* - We understand that you may question the need to take the exam when you have the freedom to select your own job track. - By taking the exam, you will gain valuable insights into your progress and learning journey, and receive expert recommendations for the most suitable job track for your specific skill set and career aspirations. - Our team of highly qualified instructors and industry experts is committed to providing you with the best possible learning experience, and the exam is an integral part of that experience. Ultimately, *the final decision on your job track choice will be yours, but taking the exam will help you make an informed decision based on your current skill level and potential*.
*l am not eligible right now but want to switch to QA/Automation Testing or Data Analytics. What should I do?* - If you are currently not eligible for taking the Fundamentals Exam and wish to switch to these tracks, we recommend completing the mandatory fundamental courses first - Static Website, Responsive Website, Programming Foundations (until functions), and Introduction to Databases (SQL). - Once you have completed these courses, you will be eligible to take the Fundamentals exam. Our team will schedule the exam every 15 days and notify you in iB com once you meet the eligibility criteria. Once you have been notified, you can take the exam and determine if the Intensive 2.0 job tracks are the right fit for you. - Please note that these courses are essential for building a strong foundation in web development and programming, and are crucial for success in any job track. We encourage you to take the time to thoroughly understand the concepts and practice the exercises before attempting the exam. - If you have any questions or concerns, our team is always available to provide support and guidance.
*What is the format of the Fundamentals Exam?* |S.No.| Exam Name|Type of Questions|Duration(min)|Timings| |:----:|:----:|:----:|:----:|:----:| |1.| SQL Exam|Multiple Choice Questions|30|6:00 PM - 6:30 PM| |2.| Projects Exam|Coding Questions in HTML & CSS|45|6:45 PM - 7:30 PM| |3.| Python Exam|Multiple Choice Questions|45|7:45 PM - 8:30 PM|
### Placements
*Will l get job opportunities from the MERN track too, if I move to QA/Automation Testing or Data Analytics?* - Yes! Please note that you will be eligible for job opportunities related to *the courses you have completed in MERN*, and also *the new job track* which you have chosen.
### Curriculum
*Why should I learn HTML & CSS if I choose Data Analytics?* - HTML and CSS are essential web technologies that allow for the creation and styling of web pages. While they may not seem directly related to data analytics, they play a crucial role in presenting data analysis results effectively. - In many data analytics jobs, you may be required to present your findings to stakeholders or clients in a clear and understandable way. HTML and CSS provide the tools to create visually appealing and easy-to-understand reports, dashboards, and presentations. - Furthermore, understanding HTML and CSS can also be helpful for web scraping, which is a common technique used in data analytics to gather data from websites. - Therefore, having a foundational knowledge of HTML and CSS can be a valuable asset in a data analytics job track. - All these will not usually be covered in other training institutions. Our robust curriculum is why 1000s of companies hired NxtWave learners.
*Why should I learn HTML & CSS if I choose QA/Automation Testing?* - Learning HTML and CSS is helpful for automation testers as it provides an understanding of web technologies and enables effective troubleshooting of issues related to web pages. - It also facilitates better collaboration with developers and assists in creating visually appealing reports. - While not essential, a basic understanding of these technologies can improve the effectiveness of automated testing. - All these will not usually be covered in other training institutions. Our robust curriculum is why 1000s of companies hired NxtWave learners.

#Industry Trends: Understanding Job Tracks in Demand and Career Prospects
#### Objective
- This cheasheet provides insights into the *current industry trends and demand for the available job tracks* (MERN Full Stack, Java Full Stack, QA/Automation Testing & Data Analytics). 
- By understanding the job tracks in demand and their career prospects, you can make informed decisions on which job track to pursue. 
- It also includes information on the distribution of positions for these job tracks. 
- In addition, the content discusses the perspective of companies on academic background and the probability of getting hired for technical roles. 
- The content concludes by emphasizing the importance of choosing a job track that aligns with the user's interests and career goals.

As you embark on your career journey, it's essential to understand the current industry trends and the opportunities available in different job tracks.

<details>
<summary>*MERN Full Stack*</summary>
- The MERN stack is becoming increasingly popular, and demand for MERN developers is on the rise. 
- MERN developers work with a range of technologies to develop and maintain web applications. 
- It is a good fit for those who are passionate about working with MERN technologies and are willing to gain expertise in web development.
</details>

<details>
<summary>*JAVA Full Stack*</summary>
- Java Full Stack developers are responsible for developing and maintaining web applications using Java technologies such as Spring, Hibernate, and Angular. 
- Java is one of the most widely used programming languages globally, making Java Full Stack a desirable job track. 
-  It is a good fit for those who want to develop enterprise web applications using Java technologies.
</details>

<details>
<summary>*QA/Automation Testing*</summary>
- Quality Assurance (QA) and Automation Testing roles involve ensuring that software products are of high quality by testing, identifying, and fixing bugs.
- The demand for QA and Automation Testing professionals is on the rise as companies strive to deliver quality products to their customers.
- This job track is suitable for those who are interested in ensuring software quality and have a passion for testing methodologies. It requires individuals to have attention to detail and problem-solving skills.</details>

<details>
<summary>*Data Analytics*</summary>
- Data Analytics involves collecting, analyzing, and interpreting large amounts of data to provide insights and solutions to complex business problems. 
- The demand for Data Analytics professionals is growing as companies increasingly rely on data-driven decision-making. 
- This job track is suitable for those who are interested in working with data and gaining insights from it. It requires individuals to have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Candidates who have a background in mathematics, statistics, or computer science are well-suited for this job track.</details>


#### Distribution of jobs:
According to the latest industry research, the distribution of jobs across various job tracks is as follows:

- MERN Full Stack (*30%-35%*)
- JAVA Full Stack (*35%-40%*)
- QA/Automation Testing (*20%-25%*)
- Data Analytics (*10%-15%*)

<MultiLineNote>
- It is important to note that these stats may vary depending on factors such as location and industry demand. 
- However, these statistics provide a general idea of the job market distribution and help you plan your career goals and make informed decisions about which job track to pursue. 
- It's also worth noting that the demand for each job track can change over time as new technologies and trends emerge in the industry.
</MultiLineNote>

#### Academic Background - Company's perspective:

- For anyone, the probability of getting hired depends on various factors such as *academic performance, relevant projects, technical skills, and communication skills*. 
- Companies generally look for candidates with a strong foundation in computer science concepts and programming languages relevant to the job role.

<MultiLineQuickTip>
- While there are opportunities available for everyone, freshers may have a relatively higher probability of getting filtered in the criteria set by the companies compared to candidates with career gaps or backlogs.
- However, this does not mean that candidates with *career gaps or backlogs* cannot get hired. They may need to *outperform other candidates and demonstrate their skills through relevant projects or certifications*, to improve their chances of being considered for the roles.
- It is recommended to opt for MERN/Java/Automation Testing for the candidates with career gap or backlogs.
</MultiLineQuickTip>

<MultiLineNote>
It's important to note that with the right skills and dedication, anyone can succeed in their chosen career path.
</MultiLineNote>

In conclusion, each job track has its own unique set of skills and demands, and *it's up to you to determine which track aligns best with your interests and career goals*. We hope this information helps you make an informed decision as you explore your career options.

All the Best!!
